Why You’ll Love This Camry

As the entry point in the Camry lineup, the LE keeps daily driving easy and reassuring with an 8-way power-adjustable driver’s seat with power lumbar support, a clear backup camera, and color-keyed heated power outside mirrors.

Backup camera

Provides a clear view of the area behind the vehicle, assisting with safe reversing and parking maneuvers.

8-way power-adjustable driver's seat with power lumbar support

Allows for precise customization of the driver's seating position, ensuring optimal comfort and support on longer drives.

Color-keyed heated power outside mirrors

Warms the mirror glass to quickly clear frost or fog, maintaining clear rearward visibility in colder conditions.

Optitron instrumentation with 4.2-in. TFT Multi-Information Display

Presents key vehicle information clearly and concisely in the driver's line of sight.

Balanced daily performance

Delivers smooth performance through its 2.5-Liter 4-Cylinder DOHC 16-Valve Dual VVT-i gasoline engine, paired with a 6-speed Electronically Controlled automatic overdrive Transmission with intelligence (ECT-i) and sequential shift mode, driving the front wheels.
